record.title: Qwen AI Platform lists Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime-Flash for duplex speech interactions
record.summary: On October 27, the Chinese-language Qwen AI Platform model changelog listed qwen-audio-3.1-realtime-flash. The entry describes real-time duplex voice conversation, text and audio input/output, tool calling, web search and voice cloning, with a stated 262,144-token context. However, the official Realtime API model-access page currently names Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime-Plus, Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime-Plus and Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime-Flash, but omits the newly listed 3.1 Flash. This documentation gap does not establish that 3.1 Flash is unavailable; no performance, price or direct endpoint test was conducted.

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: The Qwen AI Platform model-access page lists Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime-Plus, Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime-Plus and Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime-Flash as supporting AOQ, WebRTC and WebSocket, but does not list the newly cataloged 3.1 Realtime Flash variant; the omission does not establish unavailability.

evidence_gaps.description: The Oct 27 catalog entry lists 3.1 Realtime Flash, while the official model-access page reviewed names only 3.1 Plus and 3.0 Plus/Flash for AOQ, WebRTC and WebSocket. The new variant’s API access and the context specification’s application to audio sessions remain unresolved.
No matched latency, quality, price or availability comparison against 3.1 Plus or 3.0 realtime variants was conducted.

brief.importance_rationale: A distinct hosted real-time speech-model variant can broaden the available model and integration choices for multimodal agent builders if its API route is enabled. The likely consequence is useful but narrow; the catalog entry does not show measured capability or economics gains, and the current access page does not list this Flash variant.
limitations: The changelog is provider-authored; listed capabilities and context length are provider specifications, not independent results.
The linked official Realtime API page timed out in this review, so API behavior and exact model access requirements were not verified.
No price, geographic/account eligibility, measured latency, quality result or matched comparison with Qwen-Audio 3.1 Plus or 3.0 variants was established.
A 262,144-token context listing does not establish an equivalent audio-history duration or effective context for realtime speech sessions.

The official model-access page reviewed lists 3.1 Realtime Plus and both 3.0 Plus/Flash models, but not the newly listed 3.1 Realtime Flash variant. This documentation omission leaves access unresolved and is not proof of unavailability.

brief.title: Qwen AI Platform lists Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime-Flash for duplex speech interactions
brief.why_it_matters: The dated catalog entry adds a named Flash variant to Qwen’s real-time speech-model lineup, but the linked official model-access page does not yet list that variant among supported API models. This makes the catalog release visible while leaving actual API access unresolved. The source does not establish measured latency or quality or a capability advantage over listed 3.1 Plus or 3.0 variants.
